The question asks which finance specific word embedding model they use.

From the abstract: "We report a number of different evaluations using a finance specific word embedding model"

From paragraph [4]: "We additionally trained a word2vec BIBREF10 word embedding model on a set of 189,206 financial articles containing 161,877,425 tokens, that were manually downloaded from Factiva."

So they use a word2vec word embedding model trained on financial articles from Factiva.
